# AgentGuard

> A spending firewall for AI agents on NEAR. Funds stay in an on-chain vault the owner controls; the agent holds only a key that can ask to spend. A smart contract decides each request against the owner's policy, optionally with a signed verdict from a prompt-injection risk oracle running in a TEE (Intel TDX on OutLayer). Every request ends as executed, pending (waits for the owner) or denied, with a reason code.

Live on NEAR testnet: contract `guard.cm-agentguard.testnet`, public demo vault 6 (no wallet needed to read it). Agents use it through an MCP server with four tools: `agentguard_budget`, `agentguard_pay`, `agentguard_pending`, `agentguard_swap_status`. In browsers with WebMCP, this site also registers read-only tools: `agentguard_get_vault`, `agentguard_list_pending`, `agentguard_open_vault`. Nothing an agent can call here moves funds; owner actions need the owner's wallet.

## Pages

- [Home](/#/): what AgentGuard is, how a payment is decided, a try-an-attack playground (runs the oracle's rules in the browser), integrations, FAQ
- [Setup guide](/#/start): six steps to guard an agent (wallet, vault, agent key, MCP, oracle)
- [Docs](/#/docs): concepts, reason codes, policy and MCP reference, owner CLI, oracle, cross-chain, security
- [Demo vault dashboard](/?contract=guard.cm-agentguard.testnet&vault=6#/app): balances, limits, payments waiting for approval, and an activity log of every payment paid, held or refused
- [TEE vault dashboard](/?contract=guard.cm-agentguard.testnet&vault=11#/app): vault 11, whose only oracle is the verdict key held in Intel TDX on OutLayer; its activity shows a TEE-verified payment paid, an injected invoice refused (`oracle_denied`) and a spend without a verdict held

## Docs

- [How a payment is decided](/#/docs/decisions): the order of checks and every reason code
- [Policy reference](/#/docs/policy): caps, period limit, auto-approve threshold, allow and deny lists, rate limit
- [MCP tools](/#/docs/mcp): the agent interface and its environment variables
- [Owner CLI](/#/docs/cli): every owner action as a near-cli-rs command; the dashboard is optional
- [Activity and alerts](/#/docs/alerts): the vault's history, browser notifications, and agentguard-watch for ntfy, Slack, Discord or Telegram alerts
- [Risk oracle and TEE](/#/docs/oracle): prompt-injection signals, scoring, signed verdicts

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/CodeMasterLabs/agentguard): contract (Rust), SDK, MCP server, oracle (TypeScript), web app
- [README](https://github.com/CodeMasterLabs/agentguard/blob/main/README.md): overview, diagrams, quickstart, FAQ
- [Repository summary for AI readers](https://github.com/CodeMasterLabs/agentguard/blob/main/llms.txt): claims mapped to code and tests
- [Threat model](https://github.com/CodeMasterLabs/agentguard/blob/main/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md): 28 threats, each with its mitigation and evidence (a unit test or script for 22; a testnet run, the TEE manifest or a design note for the rest)
- [Testnet runs](https://github.com/CodeMasterLabs/agentguard/blob/main/docs/TESTNET.md): live end-to-end results
- [TEE oracle](https://github.com/CodeMasterLabs/agentguard-tee-oracle): the OutLayer component (its WASM is hosted on that GitHub release; a run failing with `wasm_url could not be fetched` is a hosting problem — see docs/TESTNET.md)
